1 pallet covers approx. 450 sq ft

How to measure your lawn

  1. 1. Measure the full area: Walk the perimeter and record length × width in feet for rectangular lawns.
  2. 2. Irregular lawns: Break the lawn into rectangles, measure each, and add with the Irregular shape option.
  3. 3. Subtract hardscape: Don't include driveways, patios, walkways, or garden beds in your area measurement.
  4. 4. Waste factor: Check "Curved or irregular edges" for lawns with lots of curves — it applies a 10% waste factor instead of 5% to account for trimming.

Formula: Pallets = Area × (1 + waste) ÷ 450 sq ft/pallet, rounded up. Pieces = Area × (1 + waste) ÷ 2.67 sq ft/piece. See our methodology page.

Sod quick facts

  • 1 pallet covers ~450 sq ft
  • 1 pallet ≈ 170 pieces
  • 1 piece = 16" × 24" = 2.67 sq ft
  • Straight edges: 5% waste
  • Curved/irregular: 10% waste
